title: Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
scope: The standing Kota Kinabalu City Mosque and its integral lagoon-side platforms, four minarets and dome-roofed prayer hall.
limitations: The roof levels, tower dimensions, ornamental spacing and elevations away from the documented faces are approximate.
The model includes the mosque and its fixed structural platforms. The lagoon is represented by mapped placement context and terrain rather than permanent water geometry in the mosque asset.
